messages:
ops-sre: alert: autoscaler + latency alert for dedicated pool eu-west-3-primary. Slot util ~95%, P99 generation latency jumped to ~2.1s since 03:10 UTC. Looks like throughput drop, SLA noisy-neighbor? anyone oncall?
kevin: looking. I see repeated kernel-fallbacks in runtime logs around 03:09. Kernel selector keeps toggling between matmul_fp16_fast and matmul_generic for the same model variant.
maria: that toggling will thrash the JIT and force KV cache recompute -> eviction pressure. KV hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 60% in 5m.
anya: concrete logs? can we paste the selector output and a small profile snippet?
kevin: paste: ```kernel_selector: model=gpt-medium@v4 seq=512 selected=matmul_generic (fallback from matmul_fp16_fast) latency=380ms -> next req selected=matmul_fp16_fast latency=41ms fallback_count=3```
infra-bot: note: placement-engine -> host-group-7 currently running 42 pinned slots (config max 40). Quota controller allowed burst_override=2 for service-tier=enterprise (bug #IR-1285).
luis: that explains saturation on host-group-7 + noisy neighbor. Two heavy rerank jobs got placed there earlier at 03:05 and consumed GPU SMs with sustained 100% mem/SM.
ops-sre: immediate mitigation: 1) set quota burst_override=0 for eu-west-3-primary 2) force kernel selector whitelist to prefer matmul_fp16_fast for gpt-medium@v4 (temp) 3) schedule host-group-7 drain and rebalance. Doing 1 now.
maria: also bump KV cache retention window by +30s to avoid churn while we rebalance, and enable prefix-caching for the heavy rerank route.
anya: added the kernel whitelist override: ``/api/admin/kernel-override?model=gpt-medium@v4&kernel=matmul_fp16_fast&ttl=10m`` got 200.
kevin: after override, observing stable kernel choice and P50 down to ~80ms, P99 falling from 2.1s -> 380ms within 40s. KV hit-rate recovering.
ops-sre: good. follow-ups: postmortem to include root cause chain: quota misconfig allowed >max pinned slots + placement engine packing, causing noisy neighbor + kernel selector instability + KV cache thrash. Actions: fix quota-controller validation, add placement soft-spread heuristic for latency-sensitive routes, improve kernel-selection hysteresis (avoid flip when fallback_count < 5 within 30s), and add alert when KV hit-rate drops >15% in 1m.
luis: opened follow-up tickets: IR-1285 (quota validation), INF-642 (placement spread), RTF-331 (kernel hysteresis). I'll schedule a rolling update to placement heuristics for next deploy window.
ops-sre: thanks team :thumbsup: marking incident mitigated. will post SLA impact summary to #postmortems later.
